intro: Elune's Grace is a rite of advancement for developing night elf priests, marking their readiness to wield divine talents unique to their people. Guided from local outposts like Dolanaar back to the sacred Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, candidates present themselves before Priestess Alathea to prove their devotion.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A wonderful day has come, friend. You've reached the age in which our priests are trained in abilities only Night elves know. But it is not for me to train you. You must return to the Temple of the Moon and speak to Priestess Alathea as soon as your business here is concluded. She will test you to ensure you're prepared, and only then will she teach you Elune's Grace.

clips.title: Completion
paras: By devoting yourself to Elune and our people, you have attained a state that not all of us can achieve. It is tradition that you then be taught even greater abilities for your devotion. Do you accept?
